scope: Proposition 7.5 (Quantitative K-homogeneity) of the manuscript “Witnessed symmetric choice is strictly stronger than choiceless polynomial time with counting” (preprints/Witnessed-symmetric-choice-is-strictly-stronger-than-choiceless-polynomial-time-with-counting-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 243 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d648a0d83b5f41b1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 30. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let L ≥ 2, b ∈ FV 3 , and let r, M be positive integers such that 7r + 7(6r/c)3/2 + 1 ≤ M. (7.5) If two r-tuples in Āb have the same CM -type, an element of K maps the first tuple to the second. Empty tuples lie in the same K-orbit without any width hypothesis.
